summary: Inbound SMB lead (marketing SaaS). Interested in hosted API for chat/support + KB; top ask = reduce inference cost through batching, caching, prompt compression and token audits.
notes:
11/05 discovery call w/ CEO @inboundly + Jordan (AE) + Riley (SE). Very cost-sensitive — majority of traffic is automated outbound email gen + customer support triage. Goals: keep self-serve hosted plan, stay cloud-first. Key asks: 1) sample token usage audit on 3 representative prompts (email template, support reply, KB answer); 2) actionable batching/caching config recommendations that are easy to turn on for hosted API; 3) quick-win prompt compression techniques they can ship in 1 sprint.

Call highlights:
- "We need to see $/ticket down 3-5x or we can't justify volume" — CEO.
- Current usage (estimated by client): avg user session = 6 queries, avg prompt length ~420 tokens, avg response ~850 tokens (includes KB context). They send ~8k sessions/month.
- Cost sensitivity: high; negotiating pricing for >100k tokens/day if POC looks good.
- Technical constraints: public cloud only, no VPC/private for now. SSO for admin console required.
- Preferred models: small-to-mid open models or low-cost hosted variants; open to quantized endpoints.

Recommendations shared on call (AE/SE):
- enable prefix/KV caching for KB retrievals (cache top-3 context chunks per user session) to reduce repeated context tokens.
- batch non-interactive generation (email digests) into micro-batches of 4-8 to improve GPU utilization; aim to keep latency SLO relaxed for these jobs.
- introduce prompt templates + token compression (strip metadata, short canonical state tokens, use retrieval-augmented summarization) — expect ~25-35% token reduction on KB-heavy prompts.
- run 'token audit' script (provided sample) over 7 days of traffic to baseline token distribution, then tune model size and batching.

Client quote: "If we can cut the per-ticket cost in half we scale immediately." Short, choppy CRM notes ok.

POC ask from Brightline: 2-week hosted POC with 25k token/day cap, Redwood to provide token audit + recommended batching/caching configs and estimate monthly spend at target volume.

Open items: legal needs sample terms for hosted trial; finance wants unit-cost spreadsheet; need AE to send pricing deck and sample token-audit output.
